name: Unity Animations
goalName: Create a moving platform in Unity
goal: Unity supports animations, through which a developer can easily add movement to an object or entity without coding. This allows for fast and smooth creation of many movable objects, including a platform.

approach.text: <<source Technologies, U. (2021, November 20). Unity - Manual: Creating a new Animation Clip. Unity Documentation. Retrieved November 27, 2021, from https://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/animeditor-CreatingANewAnimationClip.html>>

normalLearnings: I am able to create an animation for an object
result: As seen in the video below, the platform is moving in a rectangular motion. The player is able to physically interact with it.<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/JKhhA--Fx_8>>In the screenshot below the animation setup can be seen.<<image 2.png>>
